items.prompt: Ayu has 6 red beads and 3 blue beads. Build a part-whole model with one unit for each bead.
hints: Each unit stands for one bead.
Make one bar for each colour that Ayu has.
Red beads get 6 units and blue beads get 3 units.
items.explanation: The red part has 6 units and the blue part has 3 units. Together they make 9 units.

items.prompt: Budi picked 7 mangoes in the morning and 4 in the afternoon. Build a part-whole model with one unit for each mango.
hints: Each unit stands for one mango.
Make one bar for each time of day.
Morning gets 7 units and afternoon gets 4 units.
items.explanation: The morning part has 7 units and the afternoon part has 4 units. Together they make 11 units.

items.prompt: A shelf has 5 story books and 8 picture books. Build a part-whole model with one unit for each book.
hints: Each unit stands for one book.
Label one part for each kind of book.
Story books get 5 units and picture books get 8 units.
items.explanation: The story part has 5 units and the picture part has 8 units. The whole is 13 units.
